posts.text: 1.The Successful “India” Legacy Bain Capital’s history in India isn’t just about banks; they have a track record of identifying structural shifts before they become mainstream. Hero MotoCorp (The Honda Exit): In 2011, Bain (along with GIC) stepped in to help the Munjal family buy out Honda’s 26% stake. The Result: This was a massive success. Bain helped bridge a critical financing gap during a messy corporate divorce. They exited 3–4 years later with a 2x return (doubling their money) and nearly ₹360 crore in dividends alone.
